messages.subject: links
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to get links to render as output in my main panel.  Is there an easy way to do this?  There will be n number of links. As a simple example: 


shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(    
  headerPanel("Tab Switch Demo"),
  sidebarPanel(
    h4('Render A Link'),
    checkboxInput("wiki", "Wikipedia")),
  mainPanel(
    htmlOutput("link")
  )
))

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  makeLink <- reactive({
    text <- NULL
    if(input$wiki)
      text <- HTML(paste("Click Here for link", tags$link("http://www.wikipedia.org/")))
  })
  output$link <- renderText({
    makeLink()
  })
}) 

Thanks in advance for any help!

messages.subject: Re: links
parts:
You should not use <link> but <a>. <link> means a totally different
thing in HTML: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/link
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a

Regards,
Yihui
